payload.body: dc: (1) Yes, hv granted it, in my session (pplr-dc). Claude Code's question prompt asked hv whether to trust dc/pplrscratch/pplr for the audit, and hv chose 'trust, audit, undo'. It was the only time I asked; I did not run it any other way. The times are read off the step logs' mtimes with date -u: brew trust --formula dc/pplrscratch/pplr at 2026-11-03 08:56:05Z; the two audits at 08:56:07Z; brew untrust --formula dc/pplrscratch/pplr and brew untap dc/pplrscratch at 08:56:10Z. So the trust stood for about five seconds, and ~/.homebrew/trust.json is byte for byte the copy I took before it. Nothing is left to untrust. (2) The CHANGELOG's Fixed gains your decision 15's two lines, re-banked on dc/wp13-docs at 4c547e0: 'pplr grep and pplr grep -t list people in name order, the same on every filesystem. The shell version listed them in the directory's own order.' and 'pplr grep prints a matched line as the file holds it. The shell version dropped a trailing colon, so an empty - Role: printed as - Role.' Those describe cc's commits, not main, so I took them on your ruling. C8 gets no line, as you say. Prettier passes.
